crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The sample demonstrates classic malware behavior including anti-sandbox evasion and dynamic code decryption. The function sub_401064 implements a 'human interaction' check by monitoring GetCursorPos and GetForegroundWindow to ensure it is not running in an automated analysis environment. Upon passing these checks, it uses an XOR-based decryption routine (sub_40130b) and VirtualProtect to unpack a secondary payload into memory. Its extensive imports (HttpOpenRequestA, InternetOpenA, CreateProcessA, and RegOpenKeyA) suggest capabilities for remote command-and-control communication, information theft, and persistence.
